# TemporalSafe

> Page-level flicker/flash reducer for photosensitive and migraine users. Comfort aid — not a medical device.

- Source: https://github.com/markkirby125/temporalsafe
- Userscript: built via `npm run build` → `temporalsafe.user.js`
- Scope: page content motion only; cross-origin iframes and canvas/rAF loops are out of scope (best-effort).
